en: The postcard features an old sepia-toned photograph of a large arched brick gate with elaborate Moorish architectural details. Two people in traditional attire are in the foreground; one is riding a donkey or mule, and the other stands beside them. The gate is highly decorative, showing Islamic geometric and scalloped designs, typical of Moroccan architecture. The setting appears historical and urban.
